title: Deposit Compensating Factor for Builder Extended Rate Lock Loan Limits
content:
A buyer who has put a larger deposit into the purchase earns additional points on the allowed loan-to-value percent of a Builder Extended Rate Lock's resized loan limit, up to the term's highest loan-to-value.

**Guideline.** The deposit share is the deposits posted on the buyer's Home Purchase Agreement ledger for the agreement, reservation funds transferred to it included, as a percent of the agreement's contract price. A deposit share of 3.0 percent or more adds 1.0 point to the allowed loan-to-value percent; a deposit share of 2.0 percent up to 3.0 percent adds 0.5 point; a smaller share adds nothing. The points are added before the percent is applied to the price basis, and the allowed loan-to-value percent is never above the term's highest loan-to-value.

## Deposit bands

| Deposit share | Added |
|---|---|
| below 2.0 percent | nothing |
| 2.0 percent or more, below 3.0 percent | 0.5 point |
| 3.0 percent or more | 1.0 point |

## Ceiling by term

| Lock term | Highest loan-to-value (ceiling) |
|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 97 |
| 90-Day Lock | 97 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 95 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 95 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 90 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 90 |

## Cases (hypothetical inputs, contract price USD 500000.00, 180-Day Extended Lock)

- Deposits posted USD 17500.00: share 3.5 percent, adds 1.0. Added to 95, the percent would be 96, which is above the ceiling, so it stands at 95.
- Deposits posted USD 10000.00: share exactly 2.0 percent, adds 0.5.
- Deposits posted USD 9999.00: share below 2.0 percent, adds nothing.
